_comment: Questions for Stand On The Answer. Four answers each; the first is the right one and the game shuffles them, so you never have to think about where to put it. Keep answers short - all four are read off one line while a clock runs. Add your own: nothing in the code names any of these.
_levels: level 1 is the easiest and 5 the hardest, and a round climbs: it opens on level 1 and steps up every few questions, so everybody starts on ground they can stand on and the later questions are for whoever is still answering. A question with no level is treated as level 1. The bands do not have to be the same size.
